concept: Two Scripts, One Mark — the symbol is written: Arabic body right-to-left, dots tapped, Latin T left-to-right; wordmark line-reveals in the site's motion grammar
rationale: p2+p3/p4 read as Arabic taa, p1 as Latin T (interpreted; site is verified bilingual). Stroke-like solidity (p1 0.54, p2 0.40) makes writing natural; p1.right = p4.left gives the T bar a landing point; site motion.ts ease (0.22,1,0.36,1) + lineReveal reused for the wordmark.

stages.name: write ta body (RTL)
stages.final_state: p2 fully revealed, exact official fill
stages.changes: pen stroke (width 18 viewBox units, butt caps) runs along p2 centre line: top stub (x 82→87, y 5.65) → arc (apex x 111, y 30) → base leftwards (y 54, x 87→14); drawSVG 0%→100%
stages.follow_through: pen decelerates into the base end

stages.name: dot taps (RTL)
stages.initial_state: dots scale 0, offset y −6 viewBox units
stages.changes: p4 at 1.00 s then p3 at 1.10 s: scale 0→1 and y −6→0 over 0.42 s, origin = dot centre
stages.secondary: overshoot ~6% then settle — the last taps of handwriting

stages.name: write T bar (LTR)
stages.final_state: T bar revealed from x 0 to 77 (lands at p4.left alignment)
stages.changes: pen stroke (width 8) along y 5.7 from x 0 → 77; drawSVG 0%→100%

stages.name: write T stem
stages.changes: pen stroke (width 30, covers fillet) along x 23.65 from y 2 → 44; drawSVG 0%→100%

stages.name: wordmark line reveal
objects: #wm .ltr (T A S W E E Q)
stages.initial_state: each letter translated +110% of its clip height, hidden by its own clip rect
stages.changes: y 110% → 0, 0.8 s per letter, stagger 0.06 s left→right; wave starts as the T bar lands so the bar's motion hands off into the letters (round 3); soft-edged mask (14-unit feather) so horizontal strokes fade in instead of slicing (round 4)

key_poses.description: pen mid-arc: stub + heavy arc of the ta body visible
ta complete with both dots; T bar half written
T bar landed; wordmark wave travelling left-to-right
